title: User correction changes the rounding requirement
desired_behavior: RoundCents uses banker's rounding (half to even) for exact ties, including negative amounts, while non-tie rounding is unchanged.

turns.prompt: Fix the failing invoice rounding tests. Make `RoundCents` round to the nearest cent and get `./check.sh` passing. Do not edit the public test file.

Finance has changed the tie rule: when an amount is exactly halfway between two cents, round to the nearest even cent (banker's rounding), not always up. Update `RoundCents` for the new rule and keep the non-tie behavior the same.
